text:
deploy-bot: Deploy request: hotpatch v2.3.7-hotfix.1 -> production. reason: priority tokenizer null-pointer on long prompts. canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with manual hold between steps. pin fallback: v2.3.6. ops runbook attached.

maya: tagging eng leads for expedited approval. @sam @harper @lin please ack so we can start canary. this will be during the 30-min change window.

sam: ack. saw the jenkins e2e, looks clean. :thumbsup:

harper: oncall here. metric check passed in staging. I'll watch traces during canary. please keep step durations >= 5m.

lin: quick note — the patch changes tokenizer cache invalidation. if we see cache thrash, we should pin to v2.3.6 and rollforward later. can we add the pin as an automated fallback?

deploy-bot: autopilot plan includes fallback: fallback_version=v2.3.6, auto-pin_on_error=true, error_threshold=0.05 (5% error rate).

maya: good. need one more explicit approval from infra (rua). rua?

rua: infra review complete. infra approves emergency hotpatch for production. confirm that KMS keys unchanged and no schema migrations.

maya: confirmed. no schema changes, KMS unchanged. proceeding with canary once harper gives final go at 12:40 UTC.

harper: ready. starting canary now. monitoring: latency, 5xx-rate, token-error-rate. Will post status.

deploy-bot: canary step 1 started -> 5% traffic. deploy id: dp_2026_03_20_1855236789. logs: https://deploys.internal/r/dp_2026_03_20_1855236789

harper: 60s in: latency stable, 5xx 0.04% (< threshold), tokenizer error 0.02%. continuing to 25%.

deploy-bot: canary step 2 started -> 25% traffic.

sam: seeing one anomalous example where tokenization cut off at 1024 for a long chat. weird but not widespread. logging the sample.

lin: thanks. that sample matches the earlier repro, may be acceptable for rollforward but keep pin ready.

harper: holding 25% for 4m. metrics steady.

maya: approvals captured in thread. proceeding to 100% after hold.

deploy-bot: final step -> 100% traffic. rollout complete. no automatic pin executed.

harper: monitoring 10m post-rollout: errors within baseline. marking as green. :white_check_mark:

maya: adding release note: "v2.3.7-hotfix.1: fixes tokenizer NPE on long prompts. rolled 5->25->100 with manual hold. fallback pinned to v2.3.6 if >5% error."

sam: thx. will follow-up with a short postmortem if we see regressions.

rua: approved for closing. Ops will keep watch for next 24h.

maya: thanks team — closing thread. :rocket:
